query:
SELECT nameEn, category, unit, COUNT(*) as dataPoints, MIN(date) as earliest, MAX(date) as latest 
FROM indicators 
GROUP BY nameEn, category, unit 
ORDER BY dataPoints DESC 
LIMIT 15;
